name: MatterDraft Studio

homepage.title: Court Bundle Software for Advocates | MatterDraft Studio
homepage.description: Build court bundles on your computer. Select and order case papers, make scans searchable, and rebuild page numbers, linked indexes and bookmarks when papers change.

summary: MatterDraft Studio is a desktop app for lawyers, advocates, chambers and legal teams preparing legal documents and indexed court bundles on their computers.

faq.question: What is MatterDraft Studio?
faq.answer: MatterDraft Studio is a desktop app for advocates, chambers and legal teams. It brings PDF editing, searchable scans and court bundle preparation into one workspace.

faq.question: What does an exported court bundle include?
faq.answer: An exported bundle includes numbered pages, a linked index and bookmarks. Save one combined PDF or separate volumes with their own indexes.

faq.question: Can MatterDraft Studio make scanned PDFs searchable?
faq.answer: Yes. OCR adds searchable text to a PDF working copy. Review the recognised text against the original scan.

faq.question: What happens when I add a late annexure to a bundle?
faq.answer: Add the annexure to the matter, include it in the bundle and place it in the right order. Rebuild to update the page numbers, linked index and bookmarks, then review the new PDF before exporting it.

faq.question: Are case files uploaded to MatterDraft’s servers?
faq.answer: No. Case files, recognised text and finished bundles stay on your computer. Early access, account services and support run through the website.

faq.question: What platforms does MatterDraft Studio run on?
faq.answer: MatterDraft Studio is built for Windows and macOS.

faq.question: How can I get early access to MatterDraft Studio?
faq.answer: Check whether early access registration is open. You can sign up without entering payment details. Signups get launch updates and one month free after launch.

qualifications: Website demonstrations use fictional documents and sample data. They do not process or upload a real legal matter.
Early access registration does not require payment details. The website does not offer checkout or process purchases.
The account portal, early access and support use a network connection. The desktop document workflow keeps case files and bundles on your device.
OCR output is editable recognised text; it is not a promise of generative legal drafting or error-free recognition.
Review signature indicators and preserve signed originals. Verify signatures and check the applicable filing requirements separately.
Users must review document content, ordering, page ranges, indexes, bookmarks and other outputs before use or filing.

capabilities.title: Import and organise
capabilities.description: Import PDFs and images into a matter. Group documents into parts, select which papers go into the bundle, and choose their order. Keep other documents in the matter for reference.

capabilities.title: Recognise text with OCR
capabilities.description: OCR adds searchable text to a PDF working copy. Review the recognised text against the original scan.

capabilities.title: Explore a document template example
capabilities.description: The website example shows how fictional matter details fill in the names, dates and references in a draft.

capabilities.title: Edit and manage pages
capabilities.description: Merge and split working copies, reorder or extract pages, and review page edits while keeping the imported files intact.

capabilities.title: Collate, paginate and index
capabilities.description: Arrange documents within parts and rebuild a coordinated bundle, page numbering and index. Review updated page ranges after a change to the source order.

capabilities.title: Create and edit bookmarks
capabilities.description: Generate bookmarks from the document structure and review them alongside manual bookmark labels, page references and hierarchy.

capabilities.title: Plan document-aware volumes
capabilities.description: Set a page target for each volume and review where the bundle splits. Check the proposed boundaries for oversized documents.

capabilities.title: Validate the bundle
capabilities.description: Review missing dates, unassigned categories and numbering issues before export.

capabilities.title: Export the bundle
capabilities.description: Prepare a PDF bundle with numbered pages, an index and bookmarks. Use separate volumes when the document sequence calls for them.

capabilities.title: Apply document controls
capabilities.description: Mark redactions, protect exported PDFs with a password, add output marks and review signatures on imported files.
